title: 理解动态模因：通过开放世界知识获取实现新兴模因理解
summary: 提出Query-Retrieve-Conclude零样本框架，通过识别缺失知识、检索开放网络证据并综合背景知识，实现对动态模因的理解与检测。同时引入2024-2026年模因理解基准数据集，实验证明该方法在知识恢复、模因理解和检测任务上优于零样本基线。
summary_en: Proposes Query-Retrieve-Conclude, a zero-shot framework that identifies missing knowledge, retrieves open-web evidence, and synthesizes background knowledge for understanding and detecting evolving memes. Introduces a curated meme benchmark (2024-2026) with external knowledge annotations. Outperforms zero-shot baselines on three understanding datasets and five detection tasks.
